bullets.text: Chennai received extreme rainfall overnight, with Parrys recording 36 cm and widespread waterlogging disrupting the city.
The National Disaster Response Force deployed boats and life-saving equipment in Velachery to handle anticipated flooding.
TVK cadres intervened when a retired officer attempted to register a complaint with Minister R. Kumar regarding Velachery rains.
Residents of AGS Colony questioned how construction approvals were granted in known lake areas during Minister Kumar's inspection.
Municipal corporation workers and emergency personnel actively worked to drain stagnant rainwater pooled like ponds across Velachery.
The Okkiyam Maduvu project is highlighted as a major gamechanger to help southern Chennai manage severe floodwaters.
Velachery roads returned to normalcy following swift civic action and rainwater clearance operations by authorities.
Electricity board officials worked for eight hours to restore power in Thirumullaivoyal after a giant tree fell on a power line.
The India Meteorological Department issued an orange alert for heavy to very heavy rainfall in districts including Thiruvallur.
Ponneri recorded the highest rainfall in Thiruvallur district at 11.9 cm as Northeast monsoon showers intensified.
The MeitY Secretary highlighted at the STPI Tech Conclave that artificial intelligence can make healthcare more accessible and affordable.
The government asked Meta to ensure recommendation systems do not expose users to a limited set of narratives.
AdaniConneX announced plans to use air-cooled systems at Vizag data centres developed with Google to reduce freshwater consumption.
Chief Minister Vijay ordered in-charge ministers to return to Chennai immediately to oversee precautionary measures amid heavy rains.
The DMK IT wing questioned the background of TVK official Boopalan in relation to alleged international drug trafficking.
